name: Donate Button for PayPal by DigitalME
author: DigitalME

sections.description:
This plugin adds a lightweight Donate! button that links to your PayPal.me URL.
You can set your PayPal.me URL once in the Settings page, and use the shortcode anywhere in posts, pages, or blocks.

Features:
* Shortcode [digitalmeppb_button] to place the button anywhere
* Global settings page for PayPal.me URL under Settings → PayPal Donate Button
* Fixed text (“Donate!”) and PayPal blue styling
* Opens the link in a new tab
* Lightweight and WP.org compliant
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder donate-button-for-paypal-by-digitalme to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → PayPal Donate Button and enter your PayPal.me URL (example: https://paypal.me/yourname).
  4. Use the shortcode [digitalmeppb_button] anywhere (post, page, block) to display the Donate! button.
sections.faq:
Can I change the button text or color?

No, both are fixed to align with the project requirements.

How do I use it?

Insert [digitalmeppb_button] into any post, page, or block where you want the button to appear.
